name: Docker Build, Test, and Push
description: |
  Reusable workflow that builds a Docker image, runs tests during the build,
  tags the image with the provided tags, and optionally pushes it to Docker Hub.
inputs:
  dockerfile:
    description: Path to the Dockerfile
    required: true
  context:
    description: Build context directory
    required: true
    default: .
  image_name:
    description: Docker image name (e.g., username/repo)
    required: true
  tags:
    description: Comma‑separated list of tags to apply to the image
    required: true
  push:
    description: Whether to push the image to Docker Hub
    required: true
    default: 'false'
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Docker Buildx
      uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

    - name: Login to Docker Hub
      if: ${{ inputs.push == 'true' }}
      uses: docker/login-action@v3
      with:
        username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
        password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

    - name: Build and test image
      run: |
        docker build \
          --target test \
          -f ${{ inputs.dockerfile }} \
          ${{ inputs.context }} \
          -t ${{ inputs.image_name }}:test-${{ github.sha }}
      shell: bash

    - name: Build production image
      run: |
        docker build \
          --target production \
          -f ${{ inputs.dockerfile }} \
          ${{ inputs.context }} \
          -t ${{ inputs.image_name }}:${{ github.sha }}
      shell: bash

    - name: Tag image
      run: |
        TAGS=($(echo "${{ inputs.tags }}" | tr ',' ' '))
        for TAG in "${TAGS[@]}"; do
          docker tag ${{ inputs.image_name }}:${{ github.sha }} ${{ inputs.image_name }}:$TAG
        done
      shell: bash

    - name: Push image
      if: ${{ inputs.push == 'true' }}
      run: |
        TAGS=($(echo "${{ inputs.tags }}" | tr ',' ' '))
        for TAG in "${TAGS[@]}"; do
          docker push ${{ inputs.image_name }}:$TAG
        done
      shell: bash
